text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It's finally here: the Arima 
Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A stage reserved only for Umamusume who 
possess both popularity and talent! It's 
truly fit for a King!
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In this year's final race as well, 
the one who claims a magnificent victory 
will be me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm the first-rate Umamusume King 
Halo!

text_block_list.name: Fan Who Came to Cheer
text_block_list.text: King! We're counting on you today!

text_block_list.name: Raving Fan
text_block_list.text:
Don't lose to the others--!! Do your best! 
King--!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu... The one who belongs in everyone's 
spotlight is none other than me.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(And crowning this year with a glorious 
finish at the Arima Kinen, stepping even 
further into the limelight—)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now. King has finalllly decided to 
show up, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yo, has it been since Christmas? Glad to 
see you're doing well~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. To think that everyone would 
already be lining up to race together this 
year~...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"This is truly destiny, a fierce clash, an 
epic battle! A miraculous Special Match is 
now in sessioooon!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this... Practically everyone's 
gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's not "almost" at all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello, King-chan. I won't lose in today's 
race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
As a rival to everyone here, I'm... 
definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Aren't you full of yourself. 
Just who did you say is going to win this 
race?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. This year's Arima Kinen was 
supposed to be my stage alone, and yet...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Very well. Come along, you two.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll turn all of you into backup dancers 
for the first-rate Umamusume, King Halo!!
